# SPDX 2.3 JSON schema

`spdx-schema.json` is the JSON schema of the SPDX 2.3 specification, taken from the
`support/2.3` branch of https://github.com/spdx/spdx-spec (`schemas/spdx-schema.json`).
The SPDX specification is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported
(CC-BY-3.0). The file is test data: the tests validate every rendered SBOM against it,
and no binary links it.
